inputs.original_text: An Immigration and Customs Enforcement agent jumped into action after a baby stuck in a crowded TSA line with his family stopped breathing at JFK International Airport in New York on Thursday. Video footage released by the Department of Homeland Security showed a man holding a baby notice something wrong with the child and begin ...
inputs.modified_text: They’re packaging a frightening airport incident as an ICE-agent-hero story, with DHS itself releasing the video. That framing conveniently shifts attention from why a family was stuck in a crowded TSA line to the agency’s preferred image of its agent rushing in. The clip may show a real emergency, but it doesn’t prove the official narrative is the whole story; the release feels designed to steer public attention and manage perceptions of ICE.
